capture_query: where=APPLIEDDATE >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-16 00:00:00' OR ISSUEDDATE >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-16 00:00:00' | outFields=* | returnGeometry=true | outSR=4326 | orderByFields=PERMITNUMBER ASC

manual_comparison.note: The recent capture window carries in-progress permits; VALUATION populates at/after issuance (35,468 records carry VALUATION>0 all-time, verified live). CONTRACTOR is populated on every row — the primary trades signal. 5 records lack point geometry (null, honest).

person_vs_business: CONTRACTOR is a business-registration name (may embed an owner name, e.g. 'ADVANCED CONCEPTS LLC KOLTON RYAN PALMER'); emitted as-is as business identity, never split into a person record. No RCW list-of-individuals concern (public permit contractor of record).
robots_terms: ArcGIS Hub open-data FeatureServer, documented public API (open data license). No auth, no robots restriction on the REST endpoint. Rate: bounded windowed pulls, SOURCE_USER_AGENT.
